document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.alt: Two charts. Bar chart: percentage of workers in three sectors. 1970: agriculture 24%, industry 38%, services 38%. 1995: agriculture 11%, industry 31%, services 58%. 2020: agriculture 4%, industry 19%, services 77%. Pie chart: jobs in the service sector in 2020 — health and education 27%, retail 24%, finance and business 18%, hotels and restaurants 13%, transport 9%, other services 9%.

text: The bar chart illustrates how employment in one country was divided between agriculture, industry and services in 1970, 1995 and 2020, and the pie chart breaks down jobs in the service sector in 2020.

Overall, the economy shifted steadily towards services, which employed more than three quarters of workers by 2020, while the shares of agriculture and industry both declined. Within the service sector, health and education and retail were the largest employers.

In 1970, industry and services each accounted for 38% of jobs, and almost a quarter of workers (24%) were employed in agriculture. Over the next fifty years, the share of services doubled to 77%. At the same time, agricultural employment fell sharply to only 4%, one sixth of its 1970 level, and industry’s share halved from 38% to 19%.

Turning to the pie chart, health and education provided the largest proportion of service jobs, at 27%, followed closely by retail at 24%. Finance and business made up 18%, while hotels and restaurants accounted for 13%. Transport and other services each represented 9% of the total.

note.en: Introduces the overview — the big picture without numbers.
note.ru: Открывает overview — общий итог без цифр.

note.en: Contrasts the growth of services with the fall in the other two sectors.
note.kk: Қызмет саласының өсуін және қалған екі саланың азаюын қарсы қояды.
note.ru: Противопоставляет рост услуг и спад двух других отраслей.

note.en: Moves to the second chart: inside the service sector.
note.kk: Екінші графикке — қызмет саласының ішіне көшу.
note.ru: Переход ко второму графику — внутри сферы услуг.

note.en: Sets the period of change in one phrase.
Shows that the fall happened alongside the growth of services.
note.kk: Азаю қызмет саласының өсуімен қатар жүргенін көрсетеді.
note.ru: Показывает, что спад шёл одновременно с ростом услуг.

note.en: Moves to the second chart, so the reader sees at once where its description starts.
note.kk: Екінші графикке көшу — оқырман оның сипаттамасы қай жерден басталатынын бірден көреді.
note.ru: Переход ко второму графику — читатель сразу видит, где начинается его описание.

note.en: Compares two sectors of similar size.

strengths.en: The changes are measured — doubled, one sixth of its 1970 level, halved — not just pairs of figures.
strengths.kk: Өзгерістер бағаланған: doubled, one sixth of its 1970 level, halved — жай сандар жұбы емес.
strengths.ru: Изменения оценены: doubled, one sixth of its 1970 level, halved — не просто пары цифр.

strengths.en: “More than three quarters” and “almost a quarter” replace figures accurately and add variety.
strengths.kk: «more than three quarters», «almost a quarter» — сандардың дәл әрі әртүрлі баламасы.
strengths.ru: «more than three quarters», «almost a quarter» — точная и разнообразная замена цифр.
strengths.example: more than three quarters of workers

strengths.en: The second chart zooms into part of the first, and the writer shows this directly with “Within”.
strengths.kk: Екінші график біріншісінің бір бөлігін ашады — автор мұны «Within» сөзімен тура көрсетеді.
strengths.ru: Второй график раскрывает часть первого — и автор прямо это показывает словом «Within».

strengths.en: Two sectors of 9% each share one sentence, without repetition.
strengths.kk: 9 %-дан екі бөлік бір сөйлеммен берілген — қайталаусыз.
strengths.ru: Два сектора по 9 % описаны одним предложением — без повтора.
strengths.example: Transport and other services each represented 9% of the total

note.en: Both charts in one sentence. “Percentage of workers employed in” → “how employment was divided between”; “how jobs were divided” → “breaks down jobs”.
note.kk: Екі график бір сөйлемде. «percentage of workers employed in» → «how employment was divided between»; «how jobs were divided» → «breaks down jobs».
note.ru: Оба графика в одном предложении. «percentage of workers employed in» → «how employment was divided between»; «how jobs were divided» → «breaks down jobs».

note.en: The main shift over fifty years and the main point of the pie chart, without figures.
note.kk: 50 жылдағы басты ауысу және дөңгелек диаграмманың басты белгісі — сандарсыз.
note.ru: Главный сдвиг за 50 лет и главное на круговой — без цифр.

note.en: The bars: the 1970 starting point, then each sector with the size of its change — doubled, one sixth, halved.
note.kk: Бағандар: 1970 жылғы бастапқы нүкте, кейін әр саланың өзгерісі бағаланған — doubled, one sixth, halved.
note.ru: Столбцы: исходная точка 1970 года, потом каждая отрасль с оценкой изменения — doubled, one sixth, halved.

note.en: The pie goes from largest to smallest; equal shares are combined with “each”.
note.kk: Дөңгелек диаграмма — үлкенінен кішісіне қарай; бірдей үлестер «each» сөзімен біріктірілген.
note.ru: Круговая — от большего к меньшему; одинаковые доли объединены словом «each».

document.title: Jobs by sector
document.question:
The chart below shows the percentage of workers employed in agriculture, industry and services in one country in 1970, 1995 and 2020. The pie chart shows how jobs in the service sector were divided in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
